articles.title: GREEN TECH AND SDGS: HOW EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES ARE  RESHAPING SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT
articles.abstract:
The growth of emerging technologies like blockchain, artificial intelligence (AI), the Internet of 
Things (IoT), and sophisticated analytics demonstrates the transformative potential of green 
technology, that has significance over focusing on ecological issues and promoting 
sustainability. By addressing the prospective and limitations to the adoption of green 
technologies, this investigation aims to provide stakeholders who seek to combine 
technological innovation with sustainable development goals with useful insights. The 
investigation uses secondary data gathered from previous and current investigations to offer a 
comprehensive overview of existing knowledge and concepts to guide the analysis. The 
analysis focusses on how emerging technologies including blockchain, artificial intelligence 
(AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), and advanced analytics could encourage sustainable practices 
throughout a wide range of industries, including waste management, energy, transportation, 
agriculture, and food processing. These innovative developments demonstrate how green 
technology holds the potential to completely change a range of sectors.
